responsibility: Declares channel-based decimal text I/O for SHORTREAL values. It is the explicit-channel short-real companion to RealIO, specifying reading signed fixed or floating-point text and writing SHORTREAL values in floating, engineering, fixed, or adaptive-width forms over an IOChan channel.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the specification half of the ShortIO pair: it declares the explicit-channel SHORTREAL text I/O procedures for clients, while ShortIO.mod implements them by adapting to the broader-precision RealIO layer.
